lemmas.primary_translation: to become stuck / to become unable to leave or change

definitions.text: bli værende i ro så lenge at en blir hengende fast i underlaget eller en annen gjenstand
definitions.translation: to remain motionless for so long that one becomes stuck to the surface or another object (lit. grow attached)

examples.no: hun var som grodd fast i gulvet
examples.en: she was as if stuck to the floor

examples.no: klærne begynte å gro fast i såret
examples.en: the clothes began to grow attached to the wound

definitions.text: i overført betydning: bli værende på et sted eller i en tilstand så lenge at en ikke greier å forlate stedet eller endre tilstand
definitions.translation: figuratively: to remain in a place or state for so long that one is unable to leave the place or change the state

examples.no: jeg ønsker ikke å gro fast noe sted
examples.en: I do not want to become stuck anywhere

examples.no: gro fast i sofaen foran tv-en
examples.en: become stuck on the sofa in front of the TV
